base_patch_series.verification: intc series applies on the combined base with plain git am; resulting tree 6d0bed269425cbe676f8ff0d60df65e5473f5f41 == validated codex/intc tree; qtests_xtensa carries the single merged list [intmatrix, gdma, coreclk]

lane: intc (interrupt matrix OR/remap/disable semantics, H-CORE-02 / CORE-03)

patches.name: 0001-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_intc-model-source-OR-remap-disable.patch
patches.behavior: Interrupt matrix per TRM ch.9 on top of the coreclk reset-domain hooks: per-source level tracking; CPU extint outputs = OR of asserted mapped sources; map writes re-derive routes on both CPUs; internal-int map values (6,7,11,15,16,29) route nowhere; writes masked to 0x1f; INTR_STATUS_0..3 RO (0x18C) bounded to the documented 99 sources (word 3 carries the last 3); CLOCK_GATE (0x19C, reset 1) freezing kept; DATE (0x7FC, reset 0x02012300); MAP reset 0x10 per IDF headers; reserved slots RAZ/WI and inert (no status bit, no routing — asserted stray inputs 99..511 corrupt nothing and match no extint); real CPU lines exposed as named GPIO 'cpu-int-out'. CPU-only resets keep map+lines via the coreclk soc-reset gating; PERIPH resets restore documented defaults.

patches.name: 0002-tests-qtest-esp32s3-intmatrix-test-drive-matrix-OR-r.patch
patches.behavior: QTest on -M esp32s3 (qtest accel, no firmware): drives source GPIO inputs, intercepts cpu-int-out; 9 cases: reset defaults, single-source routing, shared-source wired-OR negative case, remap of asserted source, disabled map values + 0x1f masking, dual CPU files, status boundary (source 98 -> INTR_STATUS_3 bit 2; inputs 200/511 inert), machine reset, clock-gate freeze. Adds the conditional qtests_xtensa wiring for CONFIG_XTENSA_ESP32S3.

patches.name: 0003-tests-qtest-wire-intmatrix-test-and-align-coreclk-re.patch
patches.behavior: Stacked-integration fixes: (a) qtests_xtensa merged list runs all three ESP32-S3 suites (esp32s3-intmatrix-test, esp32s3-gdma-test, esp32s3-coreclk-test); (b) the coreclk test post-system-reset intmatrix expectation is aligned from the legacy 6 to the documented MAP reset value 0x10. No device change.

firmware_fixture.sources: TIMG0 timer0 (50) + TIMG1 timer0 (53), esp_intr_alloc_intrstatus ESP_INTR_FLAG_SHARED, sequential pinned CPU0/CPU1 passes, basic + cross patterns, bounded reboot repeat (RTC_NOINIT), OVERALL PASS boots=2
firmware_fixture.from_cpu_deviation: Requested FROM_CPU2/3 sources are the IDF 6.1 esp_ipc_isr channels (esp_ipc_isr_port.c routes FROM_CPU_2/3 to ETS_IPC_ISR_INUM at startup); routing fixture ISRs to them desynced the cross-core IPC protocol (Core 1 panic InstrFetchProhibited PC=0 in esp_ipc_isr_handler, captured in firmware-fixture-fromcpu-crash.log). TIMG0/1 T0 sources carry no other handler on the default config and make the cross pattern a true OR-persistence discriminator.

unknowns: Reserved MAP slots 99-510: RAZ/WI and inert; real silicon readback undocumented

CLOCK_GATE gated-file behavior (write-drop + output/status freeze, latch on re-enable) is register-clock domain modeling — TRM/IDF evidence covers the register itself; no silicon reference for gated-domain interrupt timing (host-only lane)
World Controller NMI masking not modeled (no WCL); routing to NMI int 14 works
coreclk lane packaging note: their series was built against the pristine base, so this lane's patches carry the full intc rework resolved with their gating hooks
